# PrecisionConfigurableSparseNvCIM

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A non-volatile compute-in-memory macro that dynamically adjusts bit precision and exploits sparsity to balance energy and resource efficiency for neural inference. Enables flexible trade-offs between accuracy and energy in edge spiking neural networks, critical for resource-constrained neuromorphic deployment.
